title: Qaffoysiyyi Baaheh Yan Quuki
intro: qeedaalissok iroh gibbate rooci raacat, waklentit kee dagar maqarak yeyyeeqeh suge. Adda xer gibdaabinitteh addat baxsimeh, Yallih taama abeyna dubuk yallih fanah yuduureh. axaxo sinni sabrii kee sorkocobaxak dooqa, qammaaliyyak daga racmatta gufte. iyyaay ta muuci miyyin diini albaab faktam qagitak xisiyyi?
clues: Anu Yalli kicna taama abeynak sugeeh, mangoomuuy, dadal le buxah maraay, meqe qaafiyat luk suge.
Tokkeek gibbati rade: gadda gexxeh, kacnoytit gexxeh, yi cado kaxxa gandit radde.
too yi xaqut yan mari yi caalat coolaysitam maduuda, kee anu dubuk raaqeh, yi dagar gandit yiggileh.
Anu inni Rabbih seece, Sheytan yoo xagem ecla kee digaalah.
Raddi kak yemeetem — amri ardi lih ibah culsaanam, kee tohuk lakal xamcin lee daylisuh culte.
Yi Rabbi gibdaabina inkitanuuk duugeh, yi buxah mara yoh gacseh, mangoh, racmatta astah abaabissah tan marah.

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verse: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding. (38:43)
